title: Evaluation of the parity circuit
statement: For every natural number $n$ and every assignment $x:\text{Fin}(n)\to\text{Bool}$, the parity circuit evaluates to the iterated exclusive-or of $x(0),\ldots,x(n-1)$, with initial value false; equivalently, its value is the parity of the assigned bits.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ assigns a Boolean value to each of the $n$ variables
